Your agents don’t need to change, and they can’t skip it. What’s available today: • The Agent Approval Protocol (AAP), an open spec, with prebuilt hooks for Claude Code and Codex, and SDKs for Python and TypeScript • withHuman itself, open source, with a hosted version that has a free plan The quickest way to try it is the Quickstart, which connects a coding agent you already use in a few minutes. There’s plenty we’re still figuring out, like giving reviewers enough context to decide, and gating calls that don’t go through MCP. We wrote more about that here:  We’d love your feedback, especially on this: which [...] Hey Product Hunt! I’m Chris, co-founder of withHuman along with Ece 👋 Before withHuman, we built an AI agent that investigated production issues and worked out fixes. It could often find the right fix. The hard part was asking a customer to let it apply that fix to their production systems. Fair enough: nobody wants to hand an agent admin access to production and hope for the best. We added an approval step, but the same problems kept coming up in conversations. Each team had different rules about who could approve what. They wanted finer control over what the agent could do. And they were already using other agents, each with its own approval setup. withHuman is what we wished existed back then. It sits between your agents and their tools and intercepts each tool call before it runs.

hey folks! been working HumanLayer for a few months now and stoked to share it with the PH community! HumanLayer was born from our frustration in trying to safely deploy AI agents in production. We were working on a set of SQL-warehouse-manager agents that would review audit logs and drop unused tables or evolve schemas. We wanted to build agents than went beyond simple recommenders or copilots, we wanted to build autonomous agents that did real work with tool calling. HumanLayer is an API and SDK that lets AI agents contact humans for feedback, input, and approvals. It's perfect for: - Implementing manual approval steps for software- and human-driven workflows - Oversight of autonomous AI agents - Managing the transition between the two There are many AI frameworks out there, but none [...] Subscribe
